name: next-and-previous-tab-chords-with-favourites
description:
The same six nextTab/previousTab chords as next-and-previous-tab-chords, against a space whose tabs are mostly held by favourite tiles: one plain row, and two tabs opened through the tiles by cmd+opt+1 and cmd+opt+2.

A tile that has claimed a tab hides that tab's row, so the space draws one row for three live tabs. The cycle walks the drawn rows, and a walk over one row has nowhere to go, which is how a key that is wired end to end still does nothing.

The cycle chords are fenced by cmd+shift+right for the same reason as the plain scenario: one space, so nextSpace always declines and the fence lines separate one chord's hotkey line from the next.

All urls are LOCAL. The VM has DNS but no outbound HTTPS.

actions.note: let the window finish first paint and the sidebar announce itself
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
open the first tile's page THROUGH the tile, which is the only way a tab gets claimed - a restored startup tab never claims one
the second tile, so two of the three live tabs are tile-held
nextTab, seeded from the core's table
previousTab, seeded from the core's table
nextTab, the chord a sibling scenario already proved on plain rows

assertions.label: both-tiles-hold-a-tab
assertions.desc: The state the rest of the run is about. Without two claims this is just a three-plain-row space and the cycle assertions below would prove nothing about favourites.

assertions.label: every-fence-reached-the-app
assertions.desc: The fences. Seven presses, seven lines, so the gap between two of them identifies the chord it belongs to.

assertions.label: all-three-next-tab-chords-fired
assertions.desc: THE assertion. A tile-held tab is somewhere the cycle must be able to go, so three nextTab chords over three live tabs move three times whether the tab wears a row or a tile.

assertions.label: no-cycle-chord-was-declined
assertions.desc: The failure this scenario was written for. A walk over one drawn row declines silently, and the decline line is what tells that apart from a chord macOS never delivered.

assertions.label: still-one-window
assertions.desc: Liveness, and a guard against a chord reaching something that opens a window.
